review.rationale: Methodological contract for Test Card T017. The evidence decision lives in docs/standard. Cycle times and doubling times are inherited from the published analysis.

question: Does the layer-3 law for unequal division give the counted population doubling time of budding yeast from its single-cell parent and daughter cycle times?

output.quantity: population doubling time T for five cycloheximide conditions
output.domain: S. cerevisiae C276 on YNB agar, 22-24 C, cycloheximide 0 to 0.060 ug/ml
output.accuracy: Standard error from sd/sqrt(22) of P and D, propagated; z per condition.

model.assumptions: Steady exponential growth; one parent cycle and one daughter cycle per division (model of Fig. 4).
model.approximation: No dispersion of cycle times; n = 22 cells per mean.
model.initial_boundary: Stable age distribution of an asynchronous population.
model.drive_environment: Growth limited by cycloheximide as published.
model.parameters: No fitting; P and D measured independently of the counted doubling time.

data_policy.holdout_policy: No holdout. Full tables seen before drafting (SEEN_FULL), declared in Test Card T017.

system_partition.boundary: Yeast microcolonies on agar under time-lapse; published values used only.

state_accounting.rule: Cells as counted in the published fields.

couplings.map: Bud emergence timed on frames every 10-20 min

observables.quantity: parent and daughter generation times; population doubling time
observables.readout_map: Published means and sd; transcribed only

observation.source_state: Exponentially growing population as in the published experiment.
observation.generated_trace: Bud emergence times; not a UET trace variable.
observation.readout: Generation times mean +- sd and counted doubling time.

error_budget.approximation: No dispersion of cycle times; one parent cycle for all parents.
error_budget.measurement: sd/sqrt(22) of P and D; the counted doubling time carries no stated error.
error_budget.systematic: n per condition is an AI choice (accepted by the author at approval); transcription checked against extracted text, not the printed page.
error_budget.omissions: Second-parent generation times not used; dispersion ignored.
error_budget.dependence: P, D and T_obs come from the same fields, so not fully independent samples.
error_budget.acceptance: Outcome categories fixed in Test Card T017.

claim_boundary: Methodological coverage of the T017 comparison only; the evidence level is set in docs/standard. Not UET-distinct (standard age-structured population dynamics).
next_action: Check the transcription against the printed page; add cycle-time dispersion if a tighter comparison is needed.
